# gitmoap_repository_chat_subscription (Resource)

The channel hears the families of events chosen — merge requests, work items, pipeline runs, releases, deployments — as a title, the repository's path, who did it and a link. The app must be in the channel. A channel shared outside the workspace hears only a public repository. Needs a maintainer of the repository.

The token needs `chat_apps:manage` and `chat_apps:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

# The Slack channels the organization's Slack app is in, by name.
data "gitmoap_group_chat_apps_slack_conversations" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}

locals {
  slack_channels = { for channel in data.gitmoap_group_chat_apps_slack_conversations.acme.items : channel.name => channel.channel_id }
}

# #api-reviews hears the api repository's merge requests and finished pipeline runs, except while
# the team freezes it: paused keeps the subscription, and the channel hears nothing.
resource "gitmoap_repository_chat_subscription" "reviews" {
  repo_id    = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  channel_id = local.slack_channels["api-reviews"]
  events     = ["merge_requests", "pipelines"]
  paused     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) Slack's id for the channel, from the conversations list. The app must be in the channel.
- `events` (List of String) What the channel hears about: one to five families.
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the channel stops hearing events for now, keeping the subscription. gitmoap pauses a subscription by itself when it can't post to the channel any more: `paused_reason` says why.

### Read-Only

- `channel_name` (String) The channel's name when it was subscribed.
- `created_at` (String) When it was made.
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `paused_reason` (String) Why it stopped posting, when it is paused: `paused` (somebody paused it), `subscriber_lost_access`
(the person who made it can no longer read what it is about) or `channel_unavailable` (Slack
refused the channel: archived, deleted, or the app was removed from it).
- `provider_info` (String) The chat app: Slack.
- `state` (String) `active`, or `paused` — by a person, or because the person who made it can no longer read what it posts.
- `subscription_id` (String) Identifies a chat channel's subscription to a repository's or a group's activity.
- `updated_at` (String) When its events or its pause last changed.

<a id="nestedatt--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `created_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor, and empty on a redacted one and on an outside author.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor and on an outside author (`imported`).
- `imported` (Attributes) An author who wrote on another host — a work item, a merge request, a comment, a release an import
brought — and whom nobody here is linked to yet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by--imported))
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.

<a id="nestedatt--created_by--imported"></a>
### Nested Schema for `created_by.imported`

Read-Only:

- `identity_id` (String) The outside author's id among the organization's imported identities.
- `login` (String) Their login on that host.
- `name` (String) Their name on that host, when it gave one.
- `profile_url` (String) Their profile's address on that host, when it gave one.
- `source_host` (String) The host they wrote on, such as `github.com`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and subscription_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_chat_subscription.example "<repo_id>/<subscription_id>"
```
